d: Shri Krishna Singh, first Chief Minister of Bihar, was known as a 'Bihar Kesari'. Some major initiatives in the state of Bihar regarding the eradication of untouchability, industrial development and establishing institutional machinery have been taken by Shri Krishna Singh during his tenure. In this episode of The Lallantop's Mukhyamantri, a special series of political stories, Editor Saurabh Dwivedi will tell the story of the first Chief Minister of Bihar.
